label: 打印平台／打印板
definition: The removable flat textured top sheet on the moving print bed. Visible sheet surface only, not the white carriage or underlying heater. An edge-on sheet may have very little visible area.
description: 承载打印件的可拆卸板面。这里介绍可见表面，不据此判断是否清洁或可开始打印。

label: 热床
definition: The visible heated bed assembly directly beneath the removable build plate. Segment exposed physical bed surfaces only; do not reuse the plate surface mask or invent the hidden heater. If fully covered, report not found.
description: 位于打印板下方，为打印提供加热支撑；被板面遮挡时，只标注可见部分，不能从图像判断温度。

label: 喷头／挤出头总成
definition: The moving print-head assembly on the horizontal X rail, including its visible front housing and attached hotend. NOT just the tiny nozzle; exclude rail, tubes and cables.
description: 沿横梁移动并输送、熔融挤出耗材。当前目标是可见工具头总成，不代表已识别其内部结构。

label: X轴横梁
definition: The exposed horizontal linear rail/beam along which the toolhead moves. Exclude the toolhead and vertical tower; visible disconnected rail sections on either side may share one instance.
description: 为工具头提供横向运动导向。被工具头遮挡的部分不补画。

label: Z轴立柱
definition: The tall vertical linear guide/tower of the printer that supports vertical movement of the X beam. Exclude X beam, head, base and the separate AMS Lite stand.
description: 为横梁的上下运动提供导向；与独立的AMS Lite支架分开识别。

label: 耗材料卷
definition: One actual reel with flanges and wound filament. Choose one clearly mounted reel, not an empty AMS arm, feeder cap or PTFE tube. If no reel is installed, report not found.
description: 储存并供应耗材。初版每类选择一个可见实例，没有安装料卷时不生成高亮。

label: 显示屏／控制面板
definition: The printer's front touchscreen assembly including its bezel, not a monitor, phone, label or AMS feeder.
description: 显示设备状态并提供操作入口。本任务只介绍与定位，不读取设备实时状态或控制打印机。

label: 电源开关
definition: An actual directly visible printer power rocker switch. Do NOT substitute the touchscreen, power cable/socket or infer a hidden rear switch. If not visible, report not found.
description: 控制打印机电源。开关未入镜时显示未定位，不能推断背面位置或通断状态。
